source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Meticulous cleaning followed by at least high-level disinfection is required before a reusable flexible bronchoscope is used again.","B":"Low-level surface disinfection is adequate when the bronchoscope was used in a client without a known infection.","C":"High-level disinfection can be performed effectively without prior cleaning of the bronchoscope channels.","D":"Reprocessing the exterior surface is sufficient because internal channels do not contact mucous membranes."}}
source_row.rationale: CDC classifies heat-sensitive flexible endoscopes such as bronchoscopes as devices that must be properly cleaned and, at minimum, undergo high-level disinfection after each use. Meticulous cleaning is necessary before high-level disinfection or sterilization.
source_row.source_detail: Flexible bronchoscopes require cleaning and at least high-level disinfection after each use Source has no separate formal version identifier in the cited page metadata; live currentness and applicability rechecked 2026-08-15. source_row.stem: A reusable flexible bronchoscope has just been used for a client. Which reprocessing step is required before the bronchoscope is used again?
